visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with dark shoulder-length hair, wearing a white T-shirt and a black sweater draped over her shoulders, walks through a bright shopping mall. She holds a blue-and-white rectangular product package. Retail clothing racks and red 'SALE' signs are visible in the background. (2) In the same mall setting, a second person wearing a blue button-down shirt and a black baseball cap runs into the frame from the left and touches the first woman's shoulder. The woman turns with a startled expression. A yellow text box appears above them. (3) The first woman continues walking through the mall corridor, gesturing with her hands while talking to the camera. Small circular inset videos of another woman's face appear frequently in the lower right and left corners, showing various expressions. (4) The scene cuts to an indoor restaurant with a red-and-white patterned bench. The woman sits at a table, using her smartphone as a mirror to apply red lipstick. She holds two different lipstick tubes during the sequence. Lighting is warm and even.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video recounts a surprising real-life encounter in a mall where a man asked the creator about her lipstick brand to buy for his partner. It then transitions into a product demonstration showing the specific lipsticks mentioned in the story, combining personal storytelling with beauty product promotion.
